summary: Oregon Dept. of Forestry lookout 8 mi SW of The Dalles: 30-ft L-4 tower built 1936, replaced 1951, since removed (date unknown); 2003 photos show footings.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com places the lookout 8 miles southwest of The Dalles; Rex's 1936 item places the parcel about seven miles due west. The story gives both bearings and does not pick one.

notes_for_editor: No source gives a removal year or describes current access, so the story says to check with the Oregon Department of Forestry. The 2003 photo captions are the only description of what remains (old foundation and tower leg bases); they are not dated later than 2003. The register (administered by Oregon Department of Forestry) and firelookout.com (Oregon Dept. of Forestry) both name ODF as the agency; Rex's header also lists Mount Hood National Forest > Oregon Department of Forestry, which the story does not repeat. The 1936 bearing (seven miles due west) differs from firelookout.com (8 miles southwest). The brief's height 9.1 m matches the 30-foot tower; the 1951 tower is the second structure. The 1953 Forest Log item is quoted via Rex's page.
